text:
Nia (Support): Escalating: Solstice trial (tenant=solstice-trial-9) onboarding failing — embed creation returns 429 then 502 on retry. Customer has a public walkthrough in 5 hours; renewal touch in 2 days. Need CS lead + short comms plan. :rotating_light:
Rafael (CS): I'm taking this as P1. Can you drop the error lines and their ingest manifest? I'll schedule a 20m remediation call and draft outbound text.
Nia (Support): Error log snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit","request_id":"r_ab12"}
Retry -> 502 upstream_read_timeout
Trace: embed-proxy -> rate-limiter -> worker-pool
```
Nia (Support): They run a webhook-driven ingest that retries on 429 and spikes concurrency.
Omar (Eng): Likely tenant hitting rate limiter due to retry storm. Short-term: (1) add per-tenant short backoff, (2) route tenant to a low-util pool, (3) temporarily increase tenant rate limit for demo window. I can flip route and bump limit now. Command: `redwoodctl tenant update solstice-trial-9 --rate=1500 --route=eu-central-low`
Kim (AM): Demo has external customers; if not fixed renewal likely delayed. They indicated intent to buy multi-seat if demo clean. I approve a goodwill credit if needed.
Rafael (CS): Proposed comms: 1) Immediate outreach: apology + 15m triage with Support+Eng in 20m. 2) If mitigation holds: 30m remediation with customer + offer $450 credit + 7-day trial extension. 3) Update renewal brief and flag for follow-up in 2 days. Kim, ok on $450 + extension?
Kim (AM): Approved $450 credit + 7-day extension. Please use: "We're sorry for the disruption; we've applied a mitigation and are crediting $450 and extending your trial by 7 days."
Nia (Support): Customer available in 18m. Shared webhook logs and SSO admin contact.
Omar (Eng): Route switched and rate limit bumped. Added tenant-level jittered backoff at the ingress layer. Monitoring shows 429s drop to near zero. I'll hold changes for the 4-hour demo window and open a PR to add a retry-signer to prevent retry storms.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-2155-002; severity=P1; assignees=Rafael (CS), Omar (Eng); created_at=2955550011
Rafael (CS): Action items for CS: - Lead remediation call and validate demo path - Provide webhook retry guidance + sample backoff code within 2 hours - Send remediation summary + credit note after call - Flag renewal in CRM for contact in 2 days
Nia (Support): Customer asked for a Node sample showing exponential backoff and a one-pager SSO checklist. I'll attach manifest and webhook payload examples.
Omar (Eng): Follow-ups: PR for ingress jittered backoff, tenant-specific rate limiter tune, and schedule night hotfix if needed. Revert route after 24h stable.
Rafael (CS): Call complete — mitigation validated, demo path exercised end-to-end. Customer appreciated quick fix; asked for a short tech review before demo. Sending remediation email and credit note now. Marking renewal as high-priority watch. :white_check_mark:
Nia (Support): Thanks everyone. Leaving ticket open until renewal follow-up confirmed.
Rafael (CS): CRM snippet to paste: "Solstice trial experienced 429 -> 502 during ingest due to webhook retry storm hitting tenant rate limiter. Temporary route + rate bump + ingress jittered backoff mitigated issue. Actions: $450 credit + 7-day trial extension; webhook backoff sample and SSO checklist delivered; eng fix queued. Renewal flagged for proactive outreach in 2 days. Contacts: Rafael (CS), Kim (AM)."
Kim (AM): Acknowledged. I'll reach out in 2 days with remediation summary and renewal ask if demo is green.
OpsBot: INC-2155-002 status=monitoring; last_update=2955550032"
